name: Protopasta PLA @base
filament_notes:
Covers Back to Basics PLA (Ingeo 4043D) and Recycled PLA.
Proto-Pasta data: 220C suits ~6 mm3/s; raise toward 240C when printing at the full 12 mm3/s cap. Getting-started range: 195-225C nozzle, 50-60C bed.
Dry below 50C if needed; printing without drying is normally fine.
